guide.summary: Palaces, the cathedral, flamenco venues and Triana's market, with tapas bars, Michelin-listed dinners, rooftop terraces and a classic confitería checked against their own websites.
highlights: Plaza de Toros de la Real Maestranza
guide.tip: The cathedral's ticket offices close at 18:00 although the visit runs until 19:00, and tickets bought online cost 13 € against 14 € at the box office.

toolkit.label: Closing days
toolkit.copy: Sobretablas serves Tuesday to Saturday and closes Sunday and Monday. Mercado de Triana's food stalls close on Sundays and holidays, though its bars open 10:00 to 17:00.

toolkit.label: Tickets and booking
toolkit.copy: Catedral de Sevilla charges 13 € online and 14 € at the box office, and online ticket holders enter by the Puerta del Lagarto. Acuario de Sevilla sells a cheaper Thursday-afternoon "Día del esPEZtador" ticket online only.

toolkit.label: Last entry
toolkit.copy: The Acuario de Sevilla stops admitting visitors an hour before closing, and Palacio de la Condesa de Lebrija's last entry is 45 minutes before closing. From 1 November, the bullring's ticket office closes at 19:00 for visits running to 19:30.

toolkit.label: Booking rules
toolkit.copy: Casa Robles charges 20 € per person for cancellations under eight hours or no-shows. Sobretablas asks you to state allergies when booking so it can adapt its tasting menu.

guide.dek: Book the cathedral and dinner tables ahead, and plan sights around early ticket-desk closing times.
intro: Seville's headline sights keep different clocks, so plan them in order. The Real Alcázar de Sevilla opens at 09:30 and, from October to March, closes at 17:00. Catedral de Sevilla opens at 10:45 Monday to Saturday but only at 14:30 on Sundays, and its ticket offices shut at 18:00. Tickets cost 13 € online or 14 € at the desk, and the time on your ticket is your entry time, with no limit on how long you stay. The cathedral also runs a free Sunday visit from 17:00 at the Puerta del Príncipe, subject to the liturgical calendar.

For a quieter palace, Casa de Pilatos opens every day from 9:00 to 18:00, charging 12 € for the main floor and 6 € for the upper floor, with an audioguide or guide included and free entry for children up to 11 with an adult. Palacio de la Condesa de Lebrija on Calle Cuna opens daily from September to June, 10:00 to 18:00, and offers a free ground-floor visit on Fridays at 10:00 with limited places. Setas de Sevilla stays open until 01:00, with last entry at 00:15, so you can save its 360º viewpoint for after dinner.

Flamenco and bullfighting history sit close together. The Museo del Baile Flamenco on Manuel Rojas Marcos runs shows at 17:00, 19:00 and 20:45, and museum entry costs 6 €. Next door on Calle Cuna, Casa de la Memoria programmes evening flamenco sessions. At the Plaza de Toros de la Real Maestranza, guided visits run 9:00 to 19:30 from 1 November, with the ticket office closing at 19:00, and they finish at 15:00 on bullfighting days. With children, the Acuario de Sevilla opens daily, until 18:00 on weekdays and 19:00 at weekends.

Eat across the river and around the cathedral. Mercado de Triana's stalls trade Monday to Saturday until 14:30, while its bars serve until midnight. Casa Robles and Restaurante Becerrita both open every day for lunch and dinner, and Becerrita serves lunch only on 24 and 31 December. Sobretablas, holding a Michelin 2026 Bib Gourmand badge, seats lunch at 13:45 and dinner at 20:15. For a drink with a view, abba The Roof Giralda serves until midnight Sunday to Thursday and until 01:00 on Fridays, Saturdays and holiday eves.
summaryCards: Start at the Real Alcázar at 09:30, then cross to the cathedral before its 18:00 ticket cut-off.
Have breakfast at Confitería Ochoa on Sierpes, then browse Mercado de Triana's stalls before they close at 14:30.
Buy cathedral tickets online to save 1 €, and cancel restaurant tables at Casa Robles at least eight hours ahead to avoid a 20 € per-person charge.

limitations: Website review, not a visit or telephone confirmation. Advertised opening, booking and exhibition details do not guarantee availability. Several sites could not be read: Plaza de España's city operator (sevilla.org, connection refused), Museo de Bellas Artes (certificate error), CaixaForum (403), Torre del Oro and Isla Mágica (domains did not resolve), Hotel Doña María and Hotel Alfonso XIII (certificate errors) and Lonja del Barranco (connection refused). Hours were not published or readable for Cañabota, El Rinconcillo, Confitería Ochoa, La Terraza del EME, Hotel Inglaterra's terrace, the Archivo General de Indias and Casa de la Memoria; the Macarena basilica publishes only a 2023-24 winter schedule; Abantal's published hours may be phone hours; and Setas de Sevilla, Palacio de Lebrija, Museo del Baile Flamenco, abba The Roof Giralda, Cervecería Giralda and Confitería Ochoa show no explicitly 2026-dated content. No specialty coffee shop or independent bakery with a readable official site was confirmed, so the coffee and bakery lists rely on one confitería.
